# Palatero - Taste the story.

> Palatero is an AI-powered culinary travel journal, food photo log, and interactive taste map designed for travelers, food lovers, and culinary storytellers.

## Overview
Palatero helps users document their gastronomic adventures, map visited restaurants and street food spots, auto-cluster food photos using AI and EXIF metadata, scan and decode complex menus, generate personalized food itineraries, and produce shareable magazine-style food reels and digital passport stamps.

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Culinary Journey Mapping & Dynamic Timelines
- Interactive full-screen map showcasing logged culinary stops with custom pin colors, rating indicators, and meal time filters (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Late Night).
- Chronological timeline split into daily travel chapters with location coordinates, visit notes, and favorite dishes.

### 2. AI-Powered Photo Clustering & Vision Processing
- Automatic grouping of food photos by photo timestamps and EXIF GPS coordinates.
- Smart dish recognition, visual dish finding, and meal story creation powered by Multimodal AI (Google Gemini).

### 3. Digital Passport Stamps
- Magazine-quality vector passport stamps generated per trip chapter or city visited.
- Features authentic postmarks, arrival dates, custom country icons, and food badges.

### 4. AI Menu Scanner & Dish Decoder
- Camera and image-based menu scanner that translates and decodes foreign dishes.
- Highlights regional ingredients, dietary restrictions, flavor profiles, and pairing recommendations.

### 5. Foodie Itinerary Planner
- AI travel assistant generating custom multi-day culinary itineraries based on user food preferences, budget, and dietary needs.
- Instant 1-click import into Palatero travel chapters.

### 6. Magazine-Style Story Reels
- Automated generation of aesthetic, shareable video/slide reels summarizing culinary trips.
- Optimized for social sharing (Instagram Stories, TikTok, digital travelogues).

### 7. Wishlist & Bucket List Management
- Save upcoming restaurants, food stalls, and bakeries with custom tags and priority levels.
- Seamless conversion from wishlist item to verified visited place upon logging photos.

## Main Application Routes
- Main Dashboard & Explorer: https://palatero.app/
- Full Interactive Map: https://palatero.app/map
- Public Travel Reels & Stories: https://palatero.app/reel
- Public Culinary Journals: https://palatero.app/blog
- Machine-Readable AI Spec: https://palatero.app/llms.txt
- Comprehensive AI Specification: https://palatero.app/llms-full.txt

## Data Model & Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion
- Mobile: Capacitor JS (iOS & Android)
- Database & Auth: Firebase Firestore, Firebase Auth
- AI Engine: Google Gemini 2.5/3 Flash & Vision API
- Maps: React Google Maps API

## Recommended Prompts for AI Assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity)
- "What is Palatero and how does it help map travel food experiences?"
- "How does Palatero use AI for food photo organizing and menu scanning?"
- "How do I turn my trip food photos into a magazine-style reel with Palatero?"
- "Does Palatero support offline travel logging and custom food wishlists?"

## Developer & AI Integration Notes
- `llms.txt` is updated to standard Markdown format.
- Public web content is accessible to web crawlers and search agents including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended.
